Resample the latent mixture component at every transition.
Replace the latent mixture with one Gaussian transition law.
Use a transition-residual Gaussian-mixture kernel rather than a persistent segment mode.
Add an explicit speed and radial/tangential decomposition to the drift design matrix.
Resample both training and rollout at one registered observation interval.
Optimize a validation-selected strictly proper energy-score scale.
Fit Gaussian drift and covariance by quasi maximum likelihood.
Use the registered mixed likelihood/energy objective or its pure-energy endpoint.
Train both spatial coordinates and compare Monte Carlo with closed Gaussian d=2 energy scoring.
Pretrain globally then update drift and diffusion on target adaptation data.
Initialize and train only on target adaptation data.
Pretrain on licensed animal trajectories then adapt to non-held-out human target segments.
Use registered first-order Reptile task initialization followed by target adaptation; do not claim second-order MAML.
Restrict target adaptation to drift or perform drift-then-diffusion two-step adaptation.
Condition drift continuously on time-aligned solar elevation.
Replace solar conditioning with none/daylight or add weather/terrain to solar conditioning.
Use the registered drift/noise split integrator.
Use Euler-Maruyama integration under either historical alias.
Propagate the learned linear Gaussian density analytically as the finite-horizon FP solution.
Use ordinary Monte Carlo or common-random-number paths for registered multi-horizon contrasts.
Condition on a registered external endpoint prior using Doob, finite-particle Schrödinger, or soft-endpoint dynamics.
